hooks.name: Append factual Kiro journal entry
hooks.description: Captures built work, Kiro capability, and one problem or lesson.

action.prompt: Before stopping, append `## <local date time>` and exactly three factual bullets to `docs/KIRO_JOURNAL.md`: what was built; which Kiro capability actually ran and how it helped; one real problem, correction, blocked permission, or lesson. Never claim unobserved hook, MCP, agent, CLI, UI, Web, or Power execution.
